Items.text: Your commands have basically killed everyone.
The only choice you made is runnning away from the battlefield, and well, you did make it.
But deep down in your heart, you know the remaining crew members hate you, right?
You thought you could wait until the time, when you rise again, then you could have regained their trust.

Items.speaker: Captain
Items.text: AY!! WHERE ARE YOU TAKING ME TO!!

Items.speaker: Captain
Items.text: UNTIE ME!! I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!

Items.speaker: Ranged
Items.text: Did you not think of that when our hearties died for you?!!!

Items.speaker: Medic
Items.text: Merlin, there is no use telling him that, he is too far gone.

Items.speaker: Medic
Items.text: Just let him go, he is not worth it.
And you feel the cold embrace of the sea as your body sinks.
BAD ENDING: REAP WHAT YOU SOW
